page.layout: One page of running text in a single main column; marginal references in the left margin (Apoc 3., Hebr 10., Rom 4., Hebr 12., Ioan 3., Matth 5., Hebr 7. and similar), each beside its paragraph. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: pro sed omnium aeternam hominum expiatione dato. Hincis Apoc 3. Et Agnus mundi occisus, quae non ita quae perunum peccata.
6. De hac oblatione, quae est tota generis humani redemptio, Peccatum ostenditur, per quam Dei gratia ... Christi, quia ... in Christo, quia ... Ioan 3.
7. Ut vero ... unum ... Dei ... Deum ... Iesus Christus ... Denique ... patrem ... Ecclesiae ...
8. Quamvis ... hominem ... Deus ... peccatorum ... ut quidem ... gratia ... Dei.
14. Sic itaque ... lege naturae ... hominis ... Deus ... salutem ...

page.notes: Page heavily worn and faded at the edges; many words in the main column are illegible and have been reduced to fragments or omitted where they could not be read with confidence. Marginal references are partly illegible.
